name: Uruuru
source:
Enigmatic and capricious twins who appear and disappear seemingly at random, nearly identical but for Uruuru's fair skin distinguishing her from [url=/c39106]Saraana's[/url] tan.
They seem to be capable of hiding themselves beyond mundane sight, and use this ability to follow [url=/c37791]Haku[/url] and his companions undetected—but to what end is unclear at best.

[From [url=http://atlus.com/uta/deception/home.html]official site[/url]]
